pairs.target: lā shā dàilái de fángzi méiyǒu qiáng . tā fàngzài jiǎng zhuōshàng , zhǐyǒu bàn rén gāo , xì mùtiáo dāchéng zhùzi hé liáng , xiàmiàn liú zhe yí dàpiàn kōng chù .
pairs.english: Lasha's house had no walls. On the teaching table, half a person's height, thin wooden strips formed posts and beams above a large open space.
pairs.hanzi:
菈莎带来的房子没有墙。
它放在讲桌上，只有半人高，细木条搭成柱子和梁，下面留着一大片空处。

pairs.target: mǐlā jìnmén biàn wǎngqián zuò , yīwén zuòzài tā pángbiān , tǎ wéi hái méi fàng hǎo bāo , sāngè rén de xīgài yǐjīng jǐ dào yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Mira took a front seat, Iven beside her. Before Tavi had put his bag down, their knees were already crowded together.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉进门便往前坐，伊文坐在她旁边，塔维还没放好包，三个人的膝盖已经挤到一起。

pairs.target: lā shā xiān cóng mùhé lǐ qǔchū zuótiān nà zhī tiětào , bǎ liǎngbàn kòu zài yìgēn zhùzi de jiētóu wàimiàn . tào shàng yǒu kǒng , mù xiāo chuān jìnqù , shàng bànjié zhùzi biàn wěn le .
pairs.english: Lasha took yesterday's iron sleeve from the case and fastened both halves around a post joint. A wooden pin through its holes steadied the upper section.
pairs.hanzi: 菈莎先从木盒里取出昨天那只铁套，把两半扣在一根柱子的接头外面。套上有孔，木销穿进去，上半截柱子便稳了。

pairs.target: " zhēnde yòng tiě xiāo . " tā shuō , " zhègēn mùtou shì shěngde lùshang guāpò bāo . "
pairs.english: “The real version uses iron pins,” she said. “This wooden one saves my bag from tearing in transit.”
pairs.hanzi: “真的用铁销。”她说，“这根木头是省得路上刮破包。”

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn wèishénme bù gāncuì yòng yì zhěnggēn zhùzi . lā shā bǎ móxíng xiàmiàn yì jié chōuchūlái , lùchū bìngpái jià zhe de zhīchēng .
pairs.english: Mira asked why not use one whole post. Lasha drew out a lower piece, showing the supports set alongside it.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问为什么不干脆用一整根柱子。菈莎把模型下面一截抽出来，露出并排架着的支撑。

pairs.target: " dǐxià huài le , yào huàn . nǐmen ruò měi huí dōu bǎ wūdǐng chāi le , shuí tì wǒ niáng kàn zào ? "
pairs.english: “If the bottom fails, replace it. Take off the roof every time and who will watch my mother's stove?”
pairs.hanzi: “底下坏了，要换。你们若每回都把屋顶拆了，谁替我娘看灶？”

pairs.target: yǒurén xiào . tǎ wéi què yìzhí kànzhe nà dào jiēfèng . tā zài lú chǎng jiàn guò tài duō chāisàn yǐhòu shuōbùchū yòngchu de dōngxī , jīntiān zhōngyú yǒu yíjiàn zài tā yǎnqián jiē huí le fángzi .
pairs.english: People laughed. Tavi watched the joint. After so much furnace scrap whose purpose was lost, here was something rejoined to a house before his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 有人笑。塔维却一直看着那道接缝。他在炉场见过太多拆散以后说不出用处的东西，今天终于有一件在他眼前接回了房子。

pairs.target: móxíng yě búshì shuō chāi jiù néng chāi . lā shā xiān zhǐ gěi tāmen kàn huàn zhù shí línshí jià zài nǎlǐ , hèzǎi zěnyàng zhuǎnguò qù .
pairs.english: Even the model could not simply be dismantled. Lasha showed the temporary supports and how they took the load during a post replacement.
pairs.hanzi: 模型也不是说拆就能拆。菈莎先指给他们看换柱时临时架在哪里，荷载怎样转过去。

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ fúzhù wūdǐng , jiào mǐlā chōudiào yìgēn bùgāi xiānchōu de chēng tiáo . wūdǐng lìkè xiàng yícè wāi , dàjiā dōu shēnshǒu , tā què yǐjīng wěnwěn tuōzhù .
pairs.english: Holding the roof herself, she had Mira remove the wrong brace. The roof tipped; everyone reached out, but she already held it secure.
pairs.hanzi: 她自己扶住屋顶，叫米拉抽掉一根不该先抽的撑条。屋顶立刻向一侧歪，大家都伸手，她却已经稳稳托住。

pairs.target: " zhēn wūzilǐ bié zhème shì . zhè shì gěi nǐ kàn tā wèishénme bùxíng . " mǐlā bǎ chēng tiáo fàng huíqù , hóngzheliǎn xiào , shuō tā fāngcái zhī xiǎng kàn nǎ gēn néngdòng , méi xiǎng guò shàngmiàn zhěngjiān wū .
pairs.english: “Not in a real house. This shows why it fails.” Mira replaced the brace, laughing with a red face: she had thought only of what moved, not the room above.
pairs.hanzi:
“真屋子里别这么试。这是给你看它为什么不行。”
米拉把撑条放回去，红着脸笑，说她方才只想看哪根能动，没想过上面整间屋。

pairs.target: dǐxià kōng zhe de dìfāng , búshì měinián dōu yānshuǐ . píngrì néng fàng chuán , xiū wǎng , háizi hái zài zhùzi jiān zhuīláizhuīqù ; shuǐ gāo le , nàxiē dōngxī jiù dé bān .
pairs.english: The space below did not flood every year. Usually it held boats and net repairs, with children chasing among the posts; high water meant moving everything.
pairs.hanzi: 底下空着的地方，不是每年都淹水。平日能放船、修网，孩子还在柱子间追来追去；水高了，那些东西就得搬。

pairs.target: lā shā shuōqǐ bāndōngxī de cìxù , xiānshì yóu hé gānliáng , hòu shì chuáng , zuì nán bān de shì shèbùdé chāi de dà guìzi .
pairs.english: Lasha described the order: oil and dry food first, then beds. Hardest was the large cupboard nobody wanted to dismantle.
pairs.hanzi: 菈莎说起搬东西的次序，先是油和干粮，后是床，最难搬的是舍不得拆的大柜子。

pairs.target: " yǒurén bù bān ma ? " yīwén wèn . " yǒu . bān dào shàngmiàn xián jǐ , bù bān yòu xián shuǐ . wǒmen yě yǒu nán shuōhuà de rén . "
pairs.english: “Do some refuse?” Iven asked. “Yes. Upstairs is too crowded, downstairs too wet. We have difficult people too.”
pairs.hanzi:
“有人不搬吗？”伊文问。
“有。搬到上面嫌挤，不搬又嫌水。我们也有难说话的人。”

pairs.target: tā ràng tāmen kàn móxíng liáng biān de yìtiáo hóngxiàn , shuō nà búshì wūzi néng chēngzhù de zuìgāo shuǐwèi , shì jiālǐ juédìng yào zǒu de shuǐwèi .
pairs.english: She showed a red line by a beam: not the highest water the house could withstand, but the level at which the family would leave.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他们看模型梁边的一条红线，说那不是屋子能撑住的最高水位，是家里决定要走的水位。

pairs.target: zài děng , wèibì yǒu chuán lái jiē . tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi zhù dé guàn de rén jiù búpà shuǐ , tīngdào zhèlǐ , hūrán juéde zìjǐ wèn bù chū nàjùhuà le .
pairs.english: Wait longer and a boat might not come. Tavi had imagined familiarity meant no fear of water; now he could not ask that question.
pairs.hanzi: 再等，未必有船来接。塔维原以为住得惯的人就不怕水，听到这里，忽然觉得自己问不出那句话了。

pairs.target: hòupái yǒurén háishì wèn , wèishénme bù bān dào shānshàng . lā shā méiyǒu lìkè huídá . tā bǎ móxíng zhuǎn le yìquān , qǔchū jǐkuài túchéng lǜsè de mùpiàn , pù zài xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: Someone in the back still asked why not move into the mountains. Without answering at once, Lasha turned the model and laid green-painted pieces below.
pairs.hanzi:
后排有人还是问，为什么不搬到山上。
菈莎没有立刻回答。她把模型转了一圈，取出几块涂成绿色的木片，铺在下面。

pairs.target: " zhè shì lú tián . nǐ bǎ tāmen yě bānshànglái ? " lú wān de rén gē lúwěi , biān xí , yě xiū yánhé yòng de chuán jù hé fángwū jiētóu .
pairs.english: “Reed fields. Will you move these uphill too?” Reedbay people cut reeds, wove mats and repaired riverboat fittings and house joints.
pairs.hanzi:
“这是芦田。你把它们也搬上来？”
芦湾的人割芦苇、编席，也修沿河用的船具和房屋接头。

pairs.target: huò búshì zhǐyǒu wǎng shānshàng sòng yìtiáo lù , wǎng xià háiyǒu jíshì , zài wǎng xī yǒu dàpiàn dàotián .
pairs.english: Goods did not travel only uphill: downstream were markets, farther west broad rice fields.
pairs.hanzi: 货不是只有往山上送一条路，往下还有集市，再往西有大片稻田。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , yòu bǔ yíjù , shānshàng ruòzhēn yǒu kěn ràng tā yìjiā zhù , yòu yǒu huó gān de dìfāng , yě búshì bùnéng tán .
pairs.english: Then she added that if the mountains offered her family a home and work, she could consider it.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完，又补一句，山上若真有肯让她一家住、又有活干的地方，也不是不能谈。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi juéde zhège dáàn gēn zìjǐ xiǎng de bù yíyàng , yòu shuōbùchū nǎlǐ bùtóng . tā búshì zhàn zài yuǎnfāng tì yuǎnfāng shuōhuà , tā yǒu yìjiān xiūzào pù , yǒu yígè bú yuàn nuó zào de mǔqīn , háiyǒu zhècì dé mǎihuíqù de tiě xiāo .
pairs.english: The answer differed from Tavi's expectations in ways he could not name. She was not speaking for a distant place; she had a repair shop, a mother reluctant to move her stove, and iron pins to buy.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维觉得这个答案跟自己想的不一样，又说不出哪里不同。她不是站在远方替远方说话，她有一间修造铺，有一个不愿挪灶的母亲，还有这次得买回去的铁销。

pairs.target: yǒu xuéshēng wèn tā huì buhuì jiè xìng . tā shuō huì yìdiǎn , xiūzào pù lǐ lìng yǒurén bǐ tā hǎo , yǎnqián zhège tàozǐ què búbì yòngdào .
pairs.english: Asked whether she practised property borrowing, she said a little; others in her shop were better. The sleeve did not need it.
pairs.hanzi: 有学生问她会不会借性。她说会一点，修造铺里另有人比她好，眼前这个套子却不必用到。

pairs.target: zhuāng dé wāi , zhǎo zài hǎo de jiè xìng shī lái , yě bùnéng bǎ yìgēn méi duìzhǔn de zhùzi shuō chéng duìzhǔn le . nài lěi zuòzài chuāng biān , tīngdào zhèlǐ xiào le yíxià .
pairs.english: Misalign a post and no brilliant practitioner could declare it aligned. Nerai smiled from the window.
pairs.hanzi:
装得歪，找再好的借性师来，也不能把一根没对准的柱子说成对准了。
奈蕾坐在窗边，听到这里笑了一下。

pairs.target: lā shā kànjiàn , wèn tā shìbushì yòu xiǎngqǐ shàngcì zhuāng fǎn de xiāng kòu . nài lěi jiào tā jìxù jiǎng fángzi , búyào jiǎng biérén de xiāngzǐ .
pairs.english: Lasha asked whether she remembered the reversed trunk clasp last time. Nerai told her to keep to houses, not other people's trunks.
pairs.hanzi: 菈莎看见，问她是不是又想起上次装反的箱扣。奈蕾叫她继续讲房子，不要讲别人的箱子。

pairs.target: sàn kè qián , lā shā ràng tāmen wéiguòlái kàn . tǎ wéi děng qiánmiàn de rén zǒukāi , wèn zhèxiē tàozǐ yǒuméiyǒu liǎnggè wān yuè de yìn .
pairs.english: Before class ended, Lasha invited them closer. Tavi waited his turn and asked if such sleeves bore two crescent marks.
pairs.hanzi: 散课前，菈莎让他们围过来看。塔维等前面的人走开，问这些套子有没有两个弯月的印。

pairs.target: tā shuō yánhé jǐjiā jiùchǎng dōu chūguò lèishì de dōngxī , guāng tīng yìnjì bùgǎn rèn ; tā ruò yǒu chǐcùn tú , kěyǐ lìng nálái .
pairs.english: Several old riverside makers produced similar things, she said; a described mark was not enough. He could bring dimensions another time.
pairs.hanzi: 她说沿河几家旧厂都出过类似的东西，光听印记不敢认；他若有尺寸图，可以另拿来。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jí zhe bǎ zhěngduàn shēnshì jiǎng gěi tā , zhī shuō zìjǐ yǐjīng gěi wù wān xiě le xìn , zài děng huíyīn .
pairs.english: He did not rush to tell his whole history, only that he had written Mistbay and awaited a reply.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有急着把整段身世讲给她，只说自己已经给雾湾写了信，在等回音。

pairs.target: lā shā diǎntóu , shuō tā de pùzi yě děng guò língjiàn huíxìn , děng dé zuì jiǔ nà huí , huò bǐ xìn xiān dào .
pairs.english: Lasha nodded: her shop waited for parts correspondence too; once the goods arrived before the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 菈莎点头，说她的铺子也等过零件回信，等得最久那回，货比信先到。

pairs.target: pángbiān de mǐlā xiǎng jiè móxíng huà yìzhāng jiētóu tú , lā shā zhǔn tā liú dào wǔhòu , dàn zìjǐ yào xiān qù lǐng huò . wéi lǎoshī jiēguò bǎoguǎn , tíxǐng tāmen bié chāi yǒu hóng jìhào de chēng tiáo .
pairs.english: Mira asked to borrow the model for a joint drawing. Lasha allowed it until afternoon but had goods to collect; Instructor Vey took charge, forbidding removal of red-marked braces.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边的米拉想借模型画一张接头图，菈莎准她留到午后，但自己要先去领货。维老师接过保管，提醒他们别拆有红记号的撑条。

pairs.target: zhèshí nài lěi bǎ lìng yìzhāng tú fàngdào zhuōbiān , shì fùjìn jiù dào huòcāng de ménkǒu .
pairs.english: Nerai laid out another drawing: the doorway of a nearby old-road warehouse.
pairs.hanzi: 这时奈蕾把另一张图放到桌边，是附近旧道货仓的门口。

pairs.target: xuégōng yǐjīng tóng nàbiān shāngliáng hǎo , guòxiētiān dài yì xiǎozǔ qù liáng ménkǎn hé tuīchē lùxiàn . lā shā yào zài tóng jiē děng xià yìbān xià xíngchuán , yuànyì yìtóng kànkàn , bǐjiào liǎngdì zěnyàng chǔlǐ shī mù hé lúnzǐ diān dòng .
pairs.english: The school had arranged a small group's threshold and cart-route survey there soon. Lasha, waiting in Copperstep for the next downstream boat, would join to compare wet-wood and wheel-jolt handling.
pairs.hanzi: 学宫已经同那边商量好，过些天带一小组去量门槛和推车路线。菈莎要在铜阶等下一班下行船，愿意一同看看，比较两地怎样处理湿木和轮子颠动。

pairs.target: búshì qù lú wān . tǎ wéi háishì gāoxìng qǐlái . tā rènde tú shàng de tuīchē , què cóngméi xiǎng guò yìzhī lúnzǐ yuèguò ménkǎn shí , xiàmiàn nà yíxià xiǎngshēng yě zhídé zhuānmén qù tīng .
pairs.english: Not Reedbay, but Tavi was pleased. He knew the cart in the drawing; he had never thought the thump beneath a wheel crossing a threshold worth a special listen.
pairs.hanzi: 不是去芦湾。塔维还是高兴起来。他认得图上的推车，却从没想过一只轮子越过门槛时，下面那一下响声也值得专门去听。

pairs.target: zǒuchū kèshì , tā huítóu kàn le yìyǎn nà zuò méiyǒu qiáng de fángzi . mǐlā yǐjīng pāxiàqù , cóng liáng de dǐxià zhǎo yígè néng kànqīng jiētóu de wèizhì , yīwén tì tā dǎng zhe kuàiyào huáluò de zhǐ . chuāng guāng chuānguò xiǎozhùzi , zhào chū yì wūzi kōngkōng de yǐngzi .
pairs.english: Leaving, he looked back at the wall-less house. Mira crouched below its beams to see a joint; Iven held her slipping paper. Window light passed through the little posts, casting a house of empty shadows.
pairs.hanzi: 走出课室，他回头看了一眼那座没有墙的房子。米拉已经趴下去，从梁的底下找一个能看清接头的位置，伊文替她挡着快要滑落的纸。窗光穿过小柱子，照出一屋子空空的影子。
